accountDeletion.title: Delete your {brand} account
accountDeletion.intro: You can permanently delete your account and all associated data at any time. Here is how it works and what gets removed.
steps: Open your Profile and scroll to the "Danger Zone" section.
Click "Delete Account" and confirm with your password (or by typing DELETE for social-login accounts).
Your account and data are deleted immediately and cannot be recovered.
dataItems: All uploaded files and knowledge-base documents
Your personal data, settings and memories
Your AI assistants and saved tasks
Group memberships you were added to
accountDeletion.retention: Deletion is permanent and takes effect immediately. Backups containing residual data are rotated out within 30 days. Data we are legally required to retain (e.g. invoices) is kept only as long as the law requires.
accountDeletion.partialTitle: Delete individual data without deleting your account
accountDeletion.partialIntro: You do not have to give up your account to remove data. While signed in you can delete any of the following yourself, and it takes effect immediately.

partialItems.name: Chats and conversations
partialItems.how: Open History, use the ⋯ menu next to a conversation and choose Delete. To remove several at once, open Statistics → All Chats, select them and choose Delete selected.

partialItems.name: Uploaded files and documents
partialItems.how: Open Sources → Browse and use the delete icon on a file, or select several and choose Delete selected. Deleting a folder also deletes the files inside it.

partialItems.name: AI-generated images and media
partialItems.how: Open Sources → Generated and use the delete icon on the item.

partialItems.name: Memories
partialItems.how: Open Memories and delete individual entries, or select several and delete them together.

partialItems.name: Connections, chat widgets and API keys
partialItems.how: Open Channels and remove the connection, widget or key you no longer need.

partialItems.name: AI assistants
partialItems.how: Open AI assistants. On your own assistant, choose Delete. A published assistant is archived first, then removed, including its files and shares.

partialItems.name: Saved tasks
partialItems.how: Open Saved tasks and choose Delete on a task you created.

partialItems.name: Groups you were added to
partialItems.how: Open My groups and choose Leave. You lose access to anything shared with that group. Memberships that come from your login cannot be left here.

accountDeletion.partialRetention: Deleted items disappear from your account immediately. Backups containing residual copies are rotated out within 30 days. Everything else in your account stays untouched.
accountDeletion.noAccessDesc: If you no longer have access to your account, contact us through our website and we will process your deletion request.

welcome.title: Welcome to
welcome.subtitle: Every AI, every feature in one place
welcome.aiNotice: By tapping “Get started” you agree that your messages, files, images and voice recordings are sent to third-party AI providers so they can answer.

ai.title: What happens to what you send
ai.body: Synaplan doesn't write the answers itself — it runs on AI models from external providers. What you send is therefore passed on to the provider of the model that is answering.
ai.point1: Only what you send is passed on: messages, files, images and voice recordings.
ai.point2: Your account information, such as your email address, is never part of those requests.
ai.point3: Which provider answers depends on the AI model you pick in the chat.

rag.title: Answers from your documents
rag.body: RAG lets the AI assistant answer from your own files, not just its general training.
rag.point1: Upload documents and ask questions about what's inside
rag.point2: Answers cite the sources they come from
rag.point3: Your files stay private to your account

widget.title: Embeddable chat widget
widget.body: Turn your knowledge into a chat widget you can embed on any website.
widget.point1: Add an AI assistant to your site in minutes
widget.point2: It answers from the documents you connect
widget.point3: Match the look to your brand
